```{python}
import pandas as pd

#import data
df = pd.read_csv("Animal Rescue incidents attended by LFB from Jan 2009.csv")

#clean data
date_format = "%d/%m/%Y %H:%M"
df["DateTimeOfCall"] = pd.to_datetime(df["DateTimeOfCall"], format=date_format)
df["AnimalGroupParent"] = df["AnimalGroupParent"].str.lower().fillna("Unknown")
df = df[df["CalYear"]<2025]
df["Month_number"] = df["DateTimeOfCall"].dt.month
df["Month"] = df["DateTimeOfCall"].dt.strftime('%b')
#df["AnimalGroupParent"].value_counts()
```


```{python}
#prepare data and convert to dictionary for observable plot
pivot = df
pivot = pivot[["Month_number", "Month","AnimalGroupParent"]].value_counts(sort=False).unstack()
pivot["total"] = pivot.sum(axis=1)
pivot = pivot.reset_index().drop(columns="Month_number").set_index("Month")
pivot = pivot[["dog", "cat",]]
pivot = pivot.to_dict(orient="dict", index=True)
pydata = []
for key, value in pivot.items():
  value['name'] = key
  pydata.append(value)

#transfer over to observable
ojs_define(pydata = pydata)
```



```{ojs}
//get python dict and flatten it, add facet position (fx, fy)
data = pydata
points = {
  const points = data.flatMap(({ name, ...values }, i) =>
    Object.entries(values).map(([key, value]) => ({
      name,
      key,
      value,
      fx: (1 + i) % 2, // trellis (facets); we leave facet <0,0> empty for the legend
      fy: 2
    }))
  );
  return points;
}
```


```{ojs}
//create scales to calculate correct coordinate system
maxValue = Math.round(d3.max(points, d => d.value) / 100) * 100
longitude = d3.scalePoint(new Set(Plot.valueof(points, "key")), [180, -180]).padding(0.5).align(1)
latitude = d3.scaleLinear([0, maxValue], [0, 0.5])
labelscale = d3.scaleLinear([0, 0.5], [0, maxValue])
```

### <span style="color:#DE1069">Cats</span> get lost in summer, <span style="color:#276EEA">dogs</span> need help all year round

#### Total cat and dog rescue incidents attended by the London fire brigade, 2010 to 2024

<br>

```{ojs}
Plot.plot({
  width: 700,

  projection: {
    type: "azimuthal-equidistant",
    rotate: [0, -90],
    
    // Note: 0.63° corresponds to max. length (here, 0.5), plus enough room for the labels
    domain: d3.geoCircle().center([0, 90]).radius(0.63)()
  },
  facet: {
    data: points,
    x: "fx",
    y: "fy",
    axis: null
  },
  color: { legend: false,  type: "categorical", range: ["#DE1069", "#276EEA"]},
  marks: [

    Plot.text(points, Plot.selectFirst({text: "name", frameAnchor: "top", fontWeight: "400", fontSize: 18,  dy: -17, dx:0})),

    // grey discs
    Plot.geo([100, 250, 400, 550, 700], {
      geometry: (r) => d3.geoCircle().center([0, 90]).radius(latitude(r))(),
      stroke: "black",
      fill: "black",
      strokeOpacity: 0.3,
      fillOpacity: 0.0,
      strokeWidth: 0.5
    }),

    // white axes
    Plot.link(longitude.domain(), {
      x1: longitude,
      y1: 90 - 0.57,
      x2: 0,
      y2: 90,
      stroke: "white",
      strokeOpacity: 0.5,
      strokeWidth: 2.5
    }),

    // tick labels
    Plot.text([100, 250, 400, 550, 700], {
      x: 180,
      y: (d) => 90 - latitude(d),
      dx: 2,
      textAnchor: "start",
      text: (d) => `${d}`,
      fill: "currentColor",
      stroke: "white",
      fontSize: 10,
   
    }),

    // axes labels
    Plot.text(longitude.domain(), {
      x: longitude,
      y: 90 - 0.57,
      text: Plot.identity,
      lineWidth: 5,
      fontSize: 14,
      fontWeight: "bold"
    }),


    // areas
    Plot.area(points, {
      x1: ({ key }) => longitude(key),
      y1: ({ value }) => 90 - latitude(value),
      x2: 0,
      y2: 90,
      fill: "name",
      stroke: "name",
      curve: "cardinal-closed"
    }),

    // points
    Plot.dot(points, {
      x: ({ key }) => longitude(key),
      y: ({ value }) => 90 - latitude(value),
      fill: "name",
      stroke: "name"
    }),

    // interactive labels
    Plot.text(
      points,
      Plot.pointer({
        x: ({ key }) => longitude(key),
        y: ({ value }) => 90 - latitude(value),
        text: (d) => `${(d.value).toFixed(0)}`,
        textAnchor: "start",
        dx: 4,
        fill: "currentColor",
        stroke: "white",
        maxRadius: 10
      })
    ),

    // interactive opacity on the areas
    () =>
      svg`<style>
          g[aria-label=area] path {fill-opacity: 0.1; transition: fill-opacity .2s;}
          g[aria-label=area]:hover path:not(:hover) {fill-opacity: 0.05; transition: fill-opacity .2s;}
          g[aria-label=area] path:hover {fill-opacity: 0.3; transition: fill-opacity .2s;}
      `
  ]
})
```
